priorityList: Maintain Agony and Corruption on your target at all times.
Cast Haunt if you have fewer than 2 stacks of Nightfall.
Summon Darkglare on cooldown, ideally when you have fewer than 3 Soul Shards.
Cast Unstable Affliction to spend Soul Shards if Darkglare is active or if you have 2 or more Soul Shards.
Cast Unstable Affliction if Shard Instability is active or if the Cascading Calamity buff is about to expire.
Use Drain Soul (or Shadow Bolt) immediately if you reach maximum Nightfall stacks or if the buff is about to expire.
Use Drain Soul (or Shadow Bolt) as a priority whenever you have more than 1 stack of Nightfall.
Use Malefic Grasp (if talented) as your primary filler while Darkglare is active.
Activate offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racials during your Darkglare window.
Cast Drain Soul (or Shadow Bolt) as a filler when no other actions are available.
